Services.title: What we build
Services.intro: Four disciplines, one point of contact: the tool and the processes it serves move forward together.

web.title: Full-stack web applications
web.text: Front ends in React, Next.js and TypeScript, back ends in Node.js or FastAPI on PostgreSQL. From internal dashboards to public websites.

mobile.title: Mobile apps and PWAs
mobile.text: React Native apps and PWAs for iOS and Android, built for slow connections, with an offline mode when the job calls for it.

automation.title: Automation and AI
automation.text: We connect your tools (CRM, forms, databases) with n8n and add AI where it saves time: sorting, summarising, pulling data out of documents.

odoo.title: Odoo and ERP
odoo.text: Odoo set up around your processes: CRM, accounting, inventory and sales, connected to the tools you already use.

Projects.title: Projects in progress
Projects.intro: Two real projects, delivered one step at a time.

ifspa.name: IFSPA
ifspa.summary: Tuition management and public website for a paramedical institute: enrolment, cash and Mobile Money payments, receipts, overdue tracking.
ifspa.delivered: Public website live, and the application screens approved by the client.
ifspa.next: Launching the application: payments, receipts, overdue fees, offline mode.
ifspa.coverAlt: Dashboard of the IFSPA tuition management app, shown with sample data
ifspa.context: IFSPA is a paramedical training institute in Toamasina, Madagascar. The project has two parts: the institute's public website, live at ifspa.mg, and a tuition management application. The application takes payments in cash or by Mobile Money (MVola, Orange, Airtel), prints thermal receipts, produces statements and tracks overdue fees with export; the payment screen works offline.

heaven.name: HAEVEN
heaven.client: Interior design studio · Mauritius and Estonia
heaven.summary: Bilingual website for a creative studio: interior design services, shop and artistic universe.
heaven.delivered: Home and Services pages designed and built, in English and French.
heaven.coverAlt: Home page of the HAEVEN website, an interior design studio
heaven.context: HAEVEN is a creative studio between Mauritius and Estonia, specialising in interior design. The project is a bilingual website, in French and English, presenting its services, its shop and its artistic universe. The home page and the Services page are done; the shop, the portfolio and the universe are still to come.
